articles.title: Meta is paying to peek at how you use their latest AI model
articles.description: For its new Muse Spark model, intended for operating coding and other agents, Meta is offering an explicit discount averaging out to about 95% for users who "contribute" to the development of future models by sharing their prompts and model outputs.

articles.title: OpenAI’s new reasoning technique alarms AI safety experts
articles.description: OpenAI’s new Astra model will use “recurrent depth,” a technique that allows the model to operate outside of the sequential thinking that characterizes most reasoning models.
